title: Bubble Voyage
description: Fun bubble shooting game, challenge three stars with your fingers. By clicking to preset the launch trajectory of the bubble, hitting the same colored bubble can eliminate it. The more bubbles left in the launcher, the richer the rewards you receive. Unlock more levels and explore the world together. Game features: 1. Enriching levels 2. Fun elimination 3. Educational Leisure
instructions: Mouse click or tap to play
